value.reason: Both evaluations present comparable evidence quality drawn from the same designs.md source. Batch offers lower call count, reduced duplication of context and findings, and preserves cross-file context. Per-file's main advantage is simplicity, but its documented downsides (duplicated context/findings, higher call count) are explicitly noted in designs.md. Since evidence quality is equivalent and the context states Batch is preferred when evidence is equal, Batch is the grounded choice.
value.uncertainty: Low. Both evaluations cite the same source material and the tie-breaking rule explicitly favors Batch when evidence quality is equal.
